test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All hands are legs.

No leg is an eye.

Conclusions:

I. All legs are hands.

II. No hand is an eye.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements:**

All hands are legs.

No leg is an eye.

The least venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35bfe69b3084bef9646bac956764bc99b91ea536acdd5befa8685bb8cfc1174c.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All legs are hands - **False**(Because, all hands are legs is given, so it can be possible only).

II. No hand is an eye - **True**(because, all hands are legs and no legs are ey, so no hand no hand is eye).

Thus, Only conclusion II follows

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
